tools.name: verify_us_business
tools.description: Looks up a company by name in the public company records of Florida, New York, California and Colorado. With state (FL, NY, CA or CO) it checks that state only; without it, every state, for when the state the company is registered in is not known. This tool is free: it checks the name, lists the leg

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_us_business" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
